This equipment is used for non-destructive (non-inductive)
measurement of the wall thickness of primary metal
surfaces of plant equipment, pipelines, pressure vessels,
and components exposed to heat, in order to timely detect
thinning caused by corrosion and erosion, as well as to
assess the technical condition of the equipment.
